newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bridgestone annual profit to hit record - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bridgestone annual profit to hit record - paper.

text.p: Bridgestone Corp is expected to post its biggest ever annual group and parent profits this year, helped by active demand for tyres in Asia and the weaker yen, a Japanese newspaper said on Wednesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that Bridgestone's parent current profit for the year to December 31, 1996, is expected to be 92 billion yen, which would be its biggest on record.
The company's group net profit in 1996 is expected to be 71 billion yen, which would also be a record for the company, the newspaper said.
Bridgestone was not immediately available for comment.
Bridgestone's actual parent current profit in 1995 was 77.36 billion yen and its actual group net profit in that year was 54.14 billion yen.
